title: Regional labour market: local indicators, LI01
description: Employment, unemployment and economic inactivity for counties, local and unitary authorities, from the Annual Population Survey. One period per release, covering April 2025 to March 2026.

files.note: The July 2026 release, sheet LI01. Holds the population aged 16 to 64, employment, unemployment and economic inactivity as both levels and rates, for a single period. Not yet read by any loader.
